name: Download workflow artifact
description: Download and extract an artifact associated with given workflow and commit or other criteria

workflow.description:
Workflow name.

If not specified, will be inferred from run_id (if run_id is specified), or will be the current workflow

workflow_search.description:
Most recent workflow matching all other criteria will be looked up instead of using the current workflow

https://docs.github.com/de/rest/actions/workflow-runs?

workflow_conclusion.description:
Wanted status or conclusion to search for in recent runs

https://docs.github.com/de/rest/actions/workflow-runs?apiVersion=2022-11-28#list-workflow-runs-for-a-w

name.description: Artifact name (download all artifacts if not specified)

name_is_regexp.description: Treat artifact name as a regular expression and download only artifacts with matching names

check_artifacts.description: Check workflow run whether it has an artifact

search_artifacts.description: Search workflow runs for artifact with specified name

skip_unpack.description: Choose to skip unpacking the downloaded artifact(s)

dry_run.description: Check the existence of artifact(s) without downloading

if_no_artifact_found.description:
Choose how to exit the action if no artifact is found

fail, warn or ignore

use_unzip.description: Use system provided `unzip` utility instead of JS library for unpacking

merge_multiple.description: If multiple artifacts are found with `name_is_regexp` set to `true`, merge them into one directory
